FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jdk-jammy AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY . .
RUN ./gradlew :ji-relay-server:installDist --no-daemon

FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jre-jammy
RUN useradd --system --uid 10001 --home-dir /nonexistent --shell /usr/sbin/nologin ji-relay
COPY --from=build /src/ji-java/applications/ji-relay-server/build/install/ji-relay /opt/ji-relay
RUN printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec wget -q -O- http://127.0.0.1:18090/api/v1/health/ready >/dev/null\n' > /opt/ji-relay/bin/healthcheck \
    && chmod 0555 /opt/ji-relay/bin/healthcheck /opt/ji-relay/bin/ji-relay
USER 10001:10001
ENTRYPOINT ["/opt/ji-relay/bin/ji-relay"]
